verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at bias reduction. Scorecard questions with AI notes mapped to them suggest structured feedback, Voice AI is pitched as a structured interview replacing the 'resume lottery', and a bias-audit statement page exists for the Talent Matching AI. Reporting covers candidates, sources, departments and custom fields, but nothing is specific to DEI. Missing for 10: structured feedback ordering (e.g., hiding others' feedback until scorecard submission), demographic-blind or anonymized review options, DEI/EEO funnel reporting, and independent corroboration.
